name: Lunar127 Virtual Raster Cube
coordinateModel: unsigned 64-bit X/Y plus 16-bit Z; no flattened index required
renderingModel: finite viewport ray sampling / slice sampling. The 10^24-voxel volume is never physically allocated.
bigtiffMaterialization: BigTIFF is used only for finite volume shards/viewports; the full virtual cube is represented by this manifest and procedural kernel.
